description: Dr. Fei-Fei Li, PhD, is a professor of computer science at Stanford University and a pioneer and expert in artificial intelligence (AI). We discuss how AI can be used safely and effectively to extend human capabilities – not just to search for information but specifically to increase human intelligence and creativity. We also discuss how humans collaborating with AI and robots stand to positively transform human health and one’s experience of life. And we cover what makes AI fundamentally differ…
classificationReason: 深度访谈讨论AI与机器人协作、机器人与AI的下一前沿，以及World Labs的空间智能。
qualityReason: 嘉宾和时间轴显示为长篇原创访谈，涵盖计算机视觉、空间智能、机器人和社会影响。
